glosses: order; command (task given to someone or something)
command (right, authority or ability to order)
lead (first place while a competition is underway)

examples.text: Qual de vocês está no comando?
examples.en: Which one of you two is in charge?

examples.text: Eu estou no comando desta missão.
examples.en: I'm in charge of this mission.

examples.text: Quem está no comando dessa unidade?
examples.en: Who's in command of this unit?
